wall_split_source: Nominal cooling capacities of one manufacturer's Australian wall-mounted split range: Daikin Australia, 2.0, 2.5, 3.5, 4.6, 5.0, 6.0 and 7.1 kW (standard and Lite series), 8.5 and 9.5 kW (XL Premium series); daikin.com.au, checked 13 November 2026. Other brands use similar but not identical steps.
ducted_source: Nominal cooling capacities of one manufacturer's Australian ducted range: Daikin Australia, 7.1 to 24.0 kW; daikin.com.au, checked 13 November 2026. Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Samsung and Actron Air publish different steps between about 5 and 28 kW.
rating_note: Nominal capacities are rated at standard test conditions (AS/NZS 3823.1.1 T1: 35 °C outside, 27 °C dry bulb / 19 °C wet bulb inside). At the site's design temperature a unit can deliver more or less: check the chosen model's capacity table at the design outdoor temperature, and its sensible capacity against the sensible load.
rule: The smallest nominal size at or above the load, with no margin added (no safety allowance: user decision 2026-10-25). A room whose load is above the largest wall split gets the fewest equal units that cover it; a whole-building load above the largest ducted size gets the fewest equal ducted units.
small_room_note: Small load: often served from a neighbouring room or a ducted outlet.
